label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows to url variable, which becomes the redirect target. Even though HTTPS prefix check exists, it does not mitigate open redirect vulnerability - attacker can provide https://evil.com/path which passes validation. Resolved sink value: url = param (when session attribute absent) or url = session value (when present). Either way, attacker-controlled data reaches redirect sink.

evidence.note: User input param flows to url, then to sendRedirect sink at line 23
